name: Elexon BMRS / Insights
used_for: Market Index (APXMIDP), system (imbalance) price, ITSDO demand, FUELINST generation and interconnectors, WINDFOR, and NDF. Interconnector pages attach the warmed FUELINST series by the exact INT fuel-type code. The map draws a schematic link, not the cable route.
attribution: Contains BMRS data © Elexon Limited copyright and database right 2026.

name: NESO Data Portal
used_for: Embedded wind, embedded wind and solar forecasts, and historic generation mix used for Year, All time, and records.
attribution: Supported by National Energy SO Open Data

name: Carbon Intensity API
used_for: National carbon intensity (actual half-hours) and a derived cleanest-window look-ahead.
attribution: National carbon intensity from the NESO Carbon Intensity API (CC BY 4.0). Developed by NESO with the University of Oxford, Environmental Defense Fund Europe and WWF.

name: Sheffield Solar PV_Live
used_for: National GB solar including estimated embedded / rooftop generation.
licence: Open access. UKERC records that PV Live data may be freely used for any purpose.
attribution: GB solar estimates from Sheffield Solar PV_Live, University of Sheffield, developed with NESO.

name: U.S. Energy Information Administration
used_for: Daily Brent, WTI, and Henry Hub prices.
licence: U.S. government work. Public domain; attribution requested.

name: World Bank Pink Sheet
used_for: Monthly Europe natural gas and Japan LNG prices.
attribution: Source: World Bank Commodity Price Data (The Pink Sheet), CC BY 4.0.

name: National Gas
used_for: Great Britain System Average Price (PUBOB603) in p/kWh. The asset directory lists NTS terminal names and does not store terminal flows or coordinates. Physical NTS flows and completed gas-day totals are published to Blob and listed on data health.
licence: National Gas Transmission confirmed in writing on 14 Oct 2026 that Grid may reuse Gas Data Portal and API data. Published as open operational data under the National Gas System Operator licence.
attribution: Data sourced from the National Gas Transmission Data Portal.

name: DESNZ Renewable Energy Planning Database
used_for: Operational renewable power stations of 150 kW and above, with OSGB36 coordinates transformed to WGS84.
attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.

name: DESNZ Digest of UK Energy Statistics
used_for: DUKES 5.11 power stations, including conventional plant, matched against REPD so the same site is not counted twice.
attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
